title: Model Quantization Methods
summary: This module provides various quantization methods for optimizing model size and inference speed, including BitNet, bitsandbytes (4-bit and 8-bit), FP8, FP-Quant, Metal, MXFP4, Quark, SINQ, and TorchAo.

nodes.label: BitNet 1.58-bit Quantization
nodes.title: BitNetHfQuantizer
nodes.description: Applies 1.58-bit quantization to model weights, converting linear layers to BitLinear for memory and speed optimization.

nodes.label: BitsAndBytes 4-bit Quantization
nodes.title: Bnb4BitHfQuantizer
nodes.description: Performs 4-bit quantization using the bitsandbytes library, reducing model size and enabling training.

nodes.label: BitsAndBytes 8-bit Quantization
nodes.title: Bnb8BitHfQuantizer
nodes.description: Applies 8-bit quantization using the bitsandbytes library, optimizing model memory footprint and supporting training.

nodes.label: Fine-Grained FP8 Quantization
nodes.title: FineGrainedFP8HfQuantizer
nodes.description: Implements FP8 quantization for both standard and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models, leveraging specific GPU hardware capabilities.

nodes.label: FP-Quant Quantization
nodes.title: FPQuantHfQuantizer
nodes.description: Handles FP-Quant method for loading pre-quantized models and performing in-flight quantization, supporting Quantization-Aware Training (QAT).

nodes.label: Metal Affine Quantization (Apple Silicon)
nodes.title: MetalHfQuantizer
nodes.description: Applies low-bit (2/4/8) affine quantization optimized for Apple Silicon (MPS) devices using specialized Metal kernels.

nodes.label: MXFP4 Quantization
nodes.title: Mxfp4HfQuantizer
nodes.description: Executes FP4 quantization using fbgemm kernels, enabling efficient model inference on compatible hardware with Triton support.

nodes.label: Quark Quantization
nodes.title: QuarkHfQuantizer
nodes.description: Integrates with the Quark library to manage model quantization, primarily for loading and processing pre-quantized models.

nodes.label: SINQ Quantization
nodes.title: SinqHfQuantizer
nodes.description: Provides weight-only SINQ and activation-aware A-SINQ quantization methods, supporting param-level conversion and serialization.

nodes.label: TorchAo Quantization
nodes.title: TorchAoHfQuantizer
nodes.description: Leverages the torchao library for various quantization types (e.g., Int4, Int8), offering model optimization and 8-bit training support.

nodes.label: PreTrainedModel
nodes.title: Base Model Class
nodes.description: The foundational class for all pre-trained models, providing common functionalities like loading and saving.

nodes.label: Weight Conversion Utility
nodes.title: Model Weight Conversion
nodes.description: Utility for converting and deserializing model weights, often used during quantization or format migration.

nodes.label: Accelerate Library
nodes.title: Distributed Training & Inference
nodes.description: A library for simplifying distributed training and inference, often used for efficient model loading and device management.

nodes.label: BitsAndBytes Library
nodes.title: Quantization Utilities
nodes.description: A library providing efficient 8-bit and 4-bit quantization routines for deep learning models.

nodes.label: PyTorch Library
nodes.title: Deep Learning Framework
nodes.description: The core PyTorch deep learning framework, providing tensor computation and neural network modules.

nodes.label: Qutlass Library
nodes.title: Blackwell GPU Quantization
nodes.description: A specialized library for quantization on Blackwell GPUs, required for real FP-Quant methods.

nodes.label: FP-Quant Library
nodes.title: FP-Quant Implementation
nodes.description: The underlying library implementing the FP-Quantization method for model optimization.

nodes.label: Kernels Library
nodes.title: Optimized Kernels
nodes.description: A library providing optimized computational kernels, used by Metal and MXFP4 quantizers for performance.

nodes.label: SINQ Library
nodes.title: SINQ Quantization Implementation
nodes.description: The core library implementing the SINQ (Symmetric INt8 Quantization) method for model compression.

nodes.label: Quark Library
nodes.title: Quark Quantization Framework
nodes.description: A framework for model quantization, used for managing and applying quantization schemes.

nodes.label: TorchAo Library
nodes.title: PyTorch Advanced Optimization
nodes.description: A PyTorch library focused on advanced optimizations, including various quantization techniques.

nodes.label: Triton Library
nodes.title: GPU Programming Language
nodes.description: A language and compiler for writing highly efficient GPU kernels, used by MXFP4 for performance.
